verdict.rationale: Blaxel's own sandbox docs describe point-in-time snapshots that can be rolled back to a checkpoint and forked into new sandboxes, which covers all three parts of the story. A separate expiration doc confirms snapshot storage is a managed concept. Missing for 10: in-depth evidence of the snapshot/restore/fork API or SDK workflow beyond a summary line, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can snapshot a sandbox and later restore or fork new sandboxes from that snapshot

citations.quote: Create point-in-time snapshots of sandboxes, roll them back to a checkpoint, and fork them into new sandboxes.
Configure expiration policies to automatically delete Blaxel sandboxes after inactivity, a TTL, or other conditions to control snapshot storage costs.
